reasoning: The question asks about the probability that the 25-year 5-month instantaneous forward rate will be higher on Oct 18 vs Oct 11, 2026. The evidence shows significant bond market volatility in the Eurozone as of early October 2026, with German 10-year yields at 3.49% (peaked at 3.65% on Sept 28), inflation rising to 3.8%, and ECB expected to hike rates further. Markets are experiencing upward pressure on yields due to inflation concerns and fiscal tensions. However, for a one-week comparison of a specific long-term forward rate, this is essentially a coin flip with slight upward bias given the current environment of rising yields and expected ECB tightening. The volatility and uncertainty suggest roughly equal probability of either direction.
